text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The autumn Tenno Sho is over. Silence Suzuka announces she wants to focus on rehabilitating her leg so she can preserve her running career.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Worried she was going to insist on continuing to run, I can't help but be shocked by her prudent choice to prioritize her health.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She says my cheers of encouragement were what gave her the strength to see the autumn Tenno Sho through.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She tells me she wishes to move forward together and continue basking in the scenery from the lead.
